policies.title: Named ordinary passports: Kyrgyz Republic 30-day Tourist eVisa
policies.summary: The live MFA application's controlling gate directly exposes Tourist (TS) for these exact passport countries, and the ordinary-passport Tourist result is an electronic, up-to-30-day visitor visa confirmed through the portal before entry.
conditions: Direct replay in one fresh retained PHP session used the form's exact country identifiers: TL 221, ID 104, PH 175, KH 38, BT 26, LA 122, TM 228, MM 152, LK 209, BD 19, PK 168, NP 155, JO 114, LB 124, IR 105, YE 245, IQ 106 and SY 216. For each, POST doc_issued_by to getList7 returned Tourist (TS).

The same session then used the Ordinary document type (doc_type=1) with Tourist (ids=56) in getVisaList_2; each direct result states that the Tourist visa is for tourism for up to 30 days. The application must be completed and paid online, and the portal says entry follows receipt of eVisa confirmation through the portal; this is electronic issuance before travel, not a border-issued visa.

The Tourist result says this category cannot be issued while the foreign national is in the Kyrgyz Republic. Grant, visa validity, carrier checks and final admission remain conditional; work, residence, transit, diplomatic, service, other-document and individual-admission routes are outside this classification.
An electronic visa received through this portal is usable only via Manas International Airport, Osh International Airport or Ak-dzol checkpoint.
The session-bound selector is mutable. Recheck the live MFA portal before travel; this finding is limited to the named ordinary passport issuers and does not create a complement rule.

application.label: Kyrgyz Republic MFA eVisa application
steps: Select the exact passport country and Ordinary travel document; proceed only where the controlling gate offers Tourist (TS).
Complete the Tourist eVisa application and online payment using the passport to be used for travel.
Receive the eVisa confirmation through the portal before entry, then use it through Manas International Airport, Osh International Airport or Ak-dzol checkpoint with the same ordinary passport.
